Maya (CSM): Halcyon onboarding health check — p50 210ms, p95 1.2s, avg token cost ~2.4x baseline. Customer: "answers are accurate but latency kills demos". Renewal in 52d. Looking for low-risk perf levers: quantization, model swap, smart routing. Thoughts?
Arjun (ML Eng): short: start with a small int4/q4 canary (10%). Usually the best risk/reward. Parallel run a redwood-v2-small experiment for throughput endpoints.
Priya (Solutions): Halcyon is in eu-central-1 on a 6x A10g Dedicated pool. They use some 4k-context flows for analytics. Any caveats for long context + q4?
Leo (Infra): q4 reduces model memory ~30-40% depending on layout, but long-context KV sizes matter. Ops risk: cold KV cache after deploy -> p95 spike. Recommend warmup replay + ephemeral mem bump during rollout.
Arjun (ML Eng): propose canary routing snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: region == "eu-central-1" && customer_id == "halcyon"
    traffic_split:
      redwood-v2-base: 80
      redwood-v2-base-q4: 10
      redwood-v2-small: 10
    rollout_window: 48h
    metrics: ["p95_latency_ms", "error_rate", "quality_delta"]
    rollback_conditions:
      - error_rate > 0.8%
      - quality_delta > 1.5%
```
Arjun (ML Eng): also run an eval pre-canary against their prompt set:
```bash
ci-eval run --model redwood-v2-base-q4 --evalset halcyon_seed.json --metrics semantic-similarity,exact_match --out evals/halcyon-q4.json
```
Aim for <1.5% similarity drop.
Ethan (Observability): I'll create a canary dashboard and alerts. Proposed alerts: p95 >800ms -> notify #customer-success; error_rate >1% for 5m -> auto-rollback; quality_delta >2% -> notify ML eng. I'll also run synthetic warmup traffic replay 30m before rollout.
Priya (Solutions): For 4k contexts we should validate q4 tensor layout; I'll pair with Arjun for a mem/throughput report and forward results here.
Sam (AE): Halcyon told our CSM: "if demos lag we pause the rollout". Target p95 <700ms would be a strong renewal signal. :warning:
Nora (CS): Can we add a short perf test that routes a small fraction of traffic to a quantized endpoint but limits to short dialogs only? That might isolate risk.
Arjun (ML Eng): yes — we can scope the redwood-v2-small split to dialog_length <= 256 for that traffic. Example match rule in routing.
Leo (Infra): I'll schedule the warmup replay and add the ephemeral mem bump for nodes serving Halcyon during the rollout. Also recommend a short pre-warm (1hr) after deploy to stabilize KV cache.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-08-15T09:00:00Z at 10% redwood-v2-base-q4 + 10% redwood-v2-small. Health checks: p95_latency_ms, error_rate, quality_delta. Console: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/halcyon-3367890123
Maya (CSM): Customer quote captured verbatim: "answers are the right ones but waiting kills the demo." I'll send the 48h canary note and schedule a +24h check-in.
Nora (CS): Plan recap: 1) Pre-canary eval and mem/throughput report (Arjun/Priya) 2) Warmup replay + mem bump (Leo) 3) Launch 10% q4 + 10% small canary scoped by dialog length (Arjun/Leo) 4) Observability + alerts (Ethan) 5) Customer comms + renewal update (Maya/Sam) 6) If metrics stable, ramp over 48-72h. Agree?
Priya (Solutions): Agree. Drafting tech note for Halcyon now.
Arjun (ML Eng): Queuing q4 build and perf bench today.
Leo (Infra): Scheduling warmup 30m pre-rollout and 1hr pre-warm after deployment.
Ethan (Observability): Dashboard created, will paste link and runbook here before rollout.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team 9;ll update renewal tracker and flag execs if p95 improves to target. :rocket:
